The sweetness of the honey permeates the meat, giving it a complex taste profile.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Glazed Meats are meals that can be made by [[Cooking]] predominantly [[Meat]] with [[Courser Bee Honey]]. Their regular version can only be made by adding a third ingredient that differs in effects from the Courser Bee Honey. They heal seven of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s and sell for 60 [[Rupee]]s. The sweetness of the honey permeates the Meat, giving it a complex taste profile. Only one variation of Glazed Meat exists: * '''Energizing Glazed Meat''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Glazed Meat}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The sweetness of honey permeates the meat, giving it a complex taste profile.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by only using Meat and Courser Bee Honey. Eating these will refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]].
